dashboard.label: AI Agent Observability — Live Demo
dashboard.description: conf26 talk demo: Your AI Is in Production. Who's Watching It?

search.query: index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 demo_source=live_agent sourcetype=ai:agent_event | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | stats count as events values(event_sourcetype) as types values(trace_id) as trace_id min(_time) as first max(_time) as last by demo_run_id user_id | eval first=strftime(first,"%H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%H:%M:%S") | eval types=mvjoin(types,", ") | table demo_run_id trace_id user_id first last events types

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:chat | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | eval message_short=substr(message, 1, 200) | sort 0 _time | table _time role user_id message_short trace_id

panel.title: Agent Workstream — What Was Actually Happening

search.query: index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:trace | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | where isnotnull(span_name) | eval step=case( span_name="user.request", "1 User request", span_name="model.turn" AND turn_seq=1, "2 Model turn 1", span_name="tool.crm_query", "3 CRM query", span_name="tool.share_config_check", "4 Share policy check", span_name="model.turn" AND turn_seq=2, "5 Model turn 2", span_name="tool.file_write", "6 File created", span_name="model.turn", "7 Final response", true(), span_name ) | eval detail=coalesce(tool_output_summary, request_summary, decision) | eval policy=coalesce(policy_action, "-") | dedup trace_id event_sequence | sort event_sequence | table _time step tool_name file_path file_hash policy detail

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | dedup trace_id metric_name | stats count as requests sum(cost_usd) as total_cost avg(duration_ms) as avg_latency_ms avg(quality_score) as avg_quality sum(input_tokens) as total_input sum(output_tokens) as total_output by model_provider model_name | eval total_cost=round(total_cost,4), avg_latency_ms=round(avg_latency_ms,0), avg_quality=round(avg_quality,2) | table model_provider model_name requests total_input total_output total_cost avg_latency_ms avg_quality

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:agent_log | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | where isnotnull(tool_name) | stats count by tool_name policy_action | sort - count
